scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const sourceDir='pags'; const targetDir='dist/pags'; fs.mkdirSync(targetDir,{recursive:true}); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(sourceDir, { withFileTypes: true })) { if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.html')) { fs.copyFileSync(path.join(sourceDir, entry.name), path.join(targetDir, entry.name)); } }" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dashboard.html')) { fs.copyFileSync('dashboard.html', 'dist/dashboard.html'); }" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('public')) { const sourceDir='public'; const targetDir='dist'; for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(sourceDir, { withFileTypes: true })) { if (entry.isFile()) { fs.copyFileSync(path.join(sourceDir, entry.name), path.join(targetDir, entry.name)); } } }"
